assertions: communication_language selects the visible locale pack
an explicit target market overrides language inference without changing the visible language
a blank target market uses a broad language market for this session only and never becomes long-term memory
Traditional Chinese does not imply Taiwan or Hong Kong; Spanish does not imply Spain; Portuguese does not imply Brazil
round 1 has exactly six fields
round 2 has exactly eight fields
each round has exactly one fenced Markdown fill-in block
the selected pack is reproduced literally without free translation or compression
Fast has exactly three columns and two next-step items
Brief and Rich have exactly twelve columns and three next-step items
Rich has style, scene, familiarity/discovery, and dynamic-combined views
only Brief and Rich expose the harmonic reorder invitation
share_feedback, export_w4dj, output_text_playlist, harmonic_reorder, and confirm_long_term_memory are present
each intent has positive, negative, and ambiguous natural-language examples
ambiguous actions request one confirmation instead of executing
long-term memory is saved only after explicit confirmation
one named platform without fallback language is exclusive
multiple named platforms are preferred in the stated order
preferred and fallback language never becomes exclusive
forbidden platforms are hard-filtered from allowed links and sources
text playlist and .w4dj actions are offered only after the complete report
.w4dj remains UTF-8 JSON with format=w4dj and format_version=2
TXT and .w4dj use the current final order after a confirmed harmonic reorder
track verification, title completeness, version-safe deduplication, key evidence, and safety rules remain unchanged
